newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher consortium wins NZ$200 mln NZ contract.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher consortium wins NZ$200 mln NZ contract.

text.p: A Fletcher Challenge -led consortium has been awarded the NZ$200 million contract to tunnel a second tailrace for the Manapouri hydro scheme, the Electricity Corporation said on Monday.

Fletcher Challenge Construction bid for the work with United States general contractor Dillingham Construction and Austrian tunnelling firm Ilbau Gesellschaft. The joint venture was one of four short-listed.
Manapouri is sited within Fiordland National Park. ECNZ plans to drill a duplicate tailrace tunnel for the underground power station to increase its peak capacity to 760 megawatts from 585 MW.
ECNZ chief executive Dave Frow said the company was pleased with the environmental sensitivity shown by all the tenderers.
The project is expected to take four years and involve 18 months to two years of tunnelling.
